summary.text: Drew Stensland is the Democratic candidate for the Iowa House of Representatives, District 75, in the November 3, 2026 general election, after advancing from the Democratic primary on June 2, 2026.
He works in community outreach and has worked in Iowa State Auditor Rob Sand's office, according to his Ballotpedia survey responses.

paragraphs.text: Stensland graduated from Cedar Falls High School and earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Northern Iowa in 2019.

In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he served as Student Body President at Cedar Falls High School and was the first student representative on the Cedar Falls School Board, and that he was elected Student Body President at the University of Northern Iowa.

Stensland said in the survey that he has worked for six years in the office of Iowa State Auditor Rob Sand, where he leads the Public Innovations and Efficiencies program, and that he serves as a local Democratic leader in Cedar Falls and Black Hawk County.
He listed strong public schools, clean water, and ending privatized Medicaid as his key campaign messages.
